audit.whatIsWrong: Primal Howl (E) was never mentioned anywhere on the page, and one foe-want credited his move speed to his passive.
audit.why: Primal Howl gives Warwick damage reduction for 2.5 seconds and then fears nearby enemies for 1 second, on a 15/14/13/12/11s cooldown — dumping a full Flux rotation into it is the single most common way to waste the trade. The move speed toward low-HP targets is Blood Hunt (W), 80s at rank 1; the passive Eternal Hunger is the heal.
audit.corrected: Primal Howl written into the Do's with its damage-reduction window and cooldown; the move-speed want reattributed to Blood Hunt with its 50%/25% thresholds.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Ryze Level 1 and Level 6 outright, while the whys under both said Warwick wins them ('the 1v1 is still his'). It then gave Warwick First item and 2+ items, where the whys describe your first even window.
audit.why: Warwick's lane is strongest from level 1 through 6; Ryze's mana items are what claw it back to even. The packet chart and the 44% win rate both describe a lane Ryze loses early and survives late.
audit.corrected: Warwick, Warwick, Warwick, Warwick, Warwick, Skill, Skill — paired full/content rows with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike stated Infinite Duress's effect with no duration and no cooldown.
audit.why: 1.5 seconds of suppression on a 110/90/70s cooldown is the whole schedule of the lane — 110 seconds of downtime at rank 1 is a long invitation.
audit.corrected: Duration and cooldown written into the spike and into the Do's.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was only in the itemization line, and nothing warned that armour is the wrong stat here.
audit.why: Jaws of the Beast deals damage based on the target's maximum health and heals him for it; Eternal Hunger's healing triples below 25%. Grievous Wounds timing, not resistances, decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds moved into the Don'ts with the 25% trigger; max-health damage written into the levels 4-5 why.

notes: The kit's derived flags call Infinite Duress a channel that 'any CC cancels'. Riot's own description does not say that, and whether Ryze's W root (as opposed to a stun or knock-up) interrupts the suppression is exactly the kind of thing the brief warns is not in the data — so nothing was written claiming the root cancels his R. Recorded in unverified. Everything on the page about Infinite Duress is framed as 'bait it, then use the downtime', which holds either way.
